title: The image of a C¹ antilipschitz chart is Borel and locally Hⁿ-finite
statement: Let Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^Q be C¹, let Ω ⊆ ℝⁿ be open, and let c > 0 with c|w − w′| ≤ |Φ(w) − Φ(w′)| for all w, w′ ∈ Ω. Then Φ(Ω) is a Borel subset of ℝ^Q, and Hⁿ(Φ(Ω) ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^Q (Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (Q n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl Q) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)), IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → MeasurableSet (Φ '' Ω) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl Q), IsCompact K → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (Φ '' Ω ∩ K) < ∞
